T: Toys at war. Snacks at peace.
D: Action figures fitted with military chips come to life and go to war in a quiet Ohio town.
P: Serve the snacks when the Commando Elite wake up in the toy shop.
S: Buttered popcorn with sprinkles, chocolate buttons and pretzel pieces

Popcorn tossed with butter and coloured sprinkles, mixed with little chocolate buttons and pretzel pieces. Pop 100g popping corn and toss with 60g melted butter. Add a big handful of coloured sprinkles while the butter is warm so they stick. Stir in chocolate buttons and broken pretzel pieces and tip into a bowl like a toy box.
Roast pumpkin, feta and sage in crisp buttered filo
Pumpkin and feta filo triangles with sage, baked at 190C for 20 minutes until golden and crisp.

Crackers lined up in rows like troops, topped with sharp cheddar, crisped salami, a slice of pickle and a dab of hot honey mustard. Lay 16 slices of salami on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp, then cool. Mix 2 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp mild mustard. Top 16 crackers with a slice of sharp cheddar, a piece of crisp salami and a round of dill pickle. Add a dab of the honey mustard and line them up on a board in neat army rows.
M: Ohio barbecue ribs with corn and slaw
Foil-baked paprika pork ribs finished over coals, grilled corn, coleslaw
Pork ribs rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, cooked at 150C for 3 hours wrapped in foil, glazed with barbecue sauce over hot coals, with corn and coleslaw.
Power pole last stand chicken burgers
Fried chicken burger, Alan's house under siege

Crispy buttermilk chicken in toasted buns with lettuce, tomato, pickles and comeback sauce. Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with salt for at least 15 minutes. Toss in the flour mixed with the paprika and fry in the oil at 170C for 7 minutes until golden and cooked through. Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and hot sauce for the comeback sauce. Toast the buns and fill with lettuce, tomato, chicken, pickles and sauce.
W: Cookie crumb base, green peppermint icing and dark chocolate on top
Chocolate biscuit base, green peppermint icing and a dark chocolate top, chilled and cut into small squares.
K: Commando Elite lime and mint fizz
Lime, mint and sugar syrup topped with soda water, served in camping mugs

Fresh lime juice muddled with mint and sugar syrup, topped with icy soda water and served in tin camping mugs, army canteen style. Dissolve 100g sugar in 100ml hot water and cool. In a jug, muddle a big handful of mint leaves with the syrup. Add the juice of 5 limes and plenty of ice. Top with 1L cold soda water and stir. Pour into four metal camping mugs and add a lime wheel and a mint sprig to each.

steps.text: Pop the corn and toss with the melted butter.
Add the sprinkles while the butter is warm so they stick.
Stir in the chocolate buttons and pretzel pieces and tip into a bowl like a toy box.
Roast the pumpkin at 200C until soft, then mash with the feta and sage.

dishes.n: Ohio barbecue ribs with corn and slaw
dishes.make_ahead: Ribs wrapped up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Rub the ribs with the paprika, sugar and salt, then wrap in foil.
Bake at 150C for 3 hours.
Brush with barbecue sauce and finish over hot coals until sticky.
Grill the corn. Toss the cabbage, carrot and mayonnaise into a crunchy coleslaw.

veg.n: Ohio barbecue cauliflower steaks with corn and slaw
veg.make_ahead: Cauliflower can be rubbed up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Cut each cauliflower into two thick steaks through the core. Rub with the oil, paprika, sugar and salt, then wrap in foil.
Bake at 200C until tender.
Unwrap, brush with barbecue sauce and finish over hot coals until sticky.
Grill the corn. Toss the cabbage, carrot and mayonnaise into a crunchy coleslaw.

Toss in the flour mixed with the paprika and fry in the oil at 170C for 7 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and hot sauce for the comeback sauce.
Toast the buns and fill with lettuce, tomato, chicken, pickles and sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the halloumi in the buttermilk up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Cut the halloumi into four thick slabs and dip in the buttermilk.
Toss in the flour mixed with the paprika and fry in the oil at 170C for 3 minutes until golden.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and hot sauce for the comeback sauce.
Toast the buns and fill with lettuce, tomato, halloumi, pickles and sauce.

Beat the icing sugar with a little butter, peppermint and green colouring and spread over.
Pour the melted chocolate on top and chill until set.
Cut into small squares.

s.note: Roast pumpkin, feta and sage in crisp buttered filo
s.how: Roast 400g diced butternut pumpkin until soft, then mash with 150g crumbled feta and chopped sage. Cut buttered filo into strips, spoon the filling at one end and fold into triangles. Brush with butter and bake at 190C for 20 minutes.

m.n: Ohio barbecue ribs with corn and slaw
m.note: Foil-baked paprika pork ribs finished over coals, grilled corn, coleslaw
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with smoked paprika, brown sugar and salt. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 3 hours. Brush with barbecue sauce and finish over hot coals until sticky. Serve with grilled corn and a crunchy cabbage coleslaw.

w.note: Cookie crumb base, green peppermint icing and dark chocolate on top
w.how: Crush 250g sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 300g icing sugar with a little butter, peppermint essence and green colouring and spread over. Pour melted dark chocolate on top, chill and cut into small squares.
